title: Choosing the Best Option
description: Reach an integrated choice by comparing needs, features, limits, and value.

stages.title: Understand the language
stages.instructions: Read the explanation, examples, common error, and recap.

blocks.text: This lesson prepares you to reach an integrated choice by comparing needs, features, limits, and value. The central language is integrated comparison review. It belongs to the practical context of comparing & choosing. Focus first on meaning: decide what information the listener needs. Then choose the subject, verb form, and useful detail. At A2, connect the main message to a time, reason, contrast, or result. Listen for context before choosing the tense or functional phrase. The same language returns in the listening, repeat, speaking, exercises, and guided conversation stages.

blocks.english: This apartment is the most convenient for us.
blocks.explanation: Use this model to begin the choosing the best option exchange.

blocks.english: It's expensive, but it has enough space.
blocks.explanation: This choosing the best option model adds a different detail or response.
Use this question or response to keep the choosing the best option exchange moving.

blocks.text: Notice the two models: “This apartment is the most convenient for us.” and “It's expensive, but it has enough space.” They show the pattern in complete communication, not as isolated grammar. Say the model aloud, replace one detail, and check that the new sentence keeps the intended meaning. When the other person asks a follow-up question, answer directly and add a relevant detail. This makes the exchange natural while keeping the language controlled. Compare the time and viewpoint in each model, and use a linker when two ideas need a clear relationship. Avoid adding advanced forms when the lesson pattern already communicates the message accurately.

blocks.title: Common error
blocks.text: Do not mix the word order or verb form with another pattern. Keep the controlled form for this lesson: integrated comparison review.
